items.title: Forecourt Mobile Shell, Owner Operations Portal & Exact Reconciliation Engine
items.summary: **Phase 1**: **Forecourt Mobile Shell, Owner Operations Portal & Exact Integer Engine**
deliverables: Rural-first mobile forecourt shell (Telugu and English) with 56-64px touch targets
Authoritative integer paise & millilitres calculation engine with 14 passing automated tests
IndianOil hierarchical receipt OCR parser with date plausibility and SHA-256 deduplication
Responsive desktop Owner operations portal covering overview, receipt inbox, shift reviews, money ledger, credit khata, people, pumps, and daily reports
Zero-trust Firestore security rules, compound indexes, and Cloud Storage security configuration
Compiled Web release and installable Android debug APK (app-debug.apk)
gates: All 14 unit and widget tests passing
items.next_action: Begin Phase 2: Live Firebase Auth Phone OTP binding and Cloud Functions integration.

changes.title: Prevent purged handover resurrection and retire older APK downloads
changes.summary: Published signed stable Patch 3 for base v1.0.33+34 and website revision 20261012171506-81291e1b070e297f. Removed six retired public APK files; older version links redirect to the current APK and retired release entries are hidden. Purge stores local handover tombstones, uses server-only deletion reads and shows incomplete cloud deletion in red. 126 Flutter tests including stale-cache resurrection regression and 22 release checks passed; published revision/code/current APK hashes and older-link redirects verified. Firebase HTTP 429 Quota exceeded blocked deletion of 17 older cloud release records; four cloud handovers remain until the owner retries purge successfully. Physical-device testing skipped under standing owner authorization. No live financial records were deleted by maintenance.

changes.title: Remove duplicate role and permission editor from Settings
changes.summary: Removed duplicate Roles & Screen Permissions editor from compact and wide Settings. Dedicated Roles and Permissions screens and scanner controls remain. Deployed signed stable Patch 2 for v1.0.33+34 and website revision 20261012165537-7e7bac6d42d2f5c3. 125 Flutter tests, 22 release checks, web build, live revision/code/APK hashes passed. Physical-device testing skipped under standing owner authorization; original migration APK retained.

changes.title: Owner-authorized stable Patch 1 and website deployment without device testing
changes.summary: Deployed signed Shorebird Patch 1 to stable for v1.0.33+34 and published matching website revision 20261012153722-f54e05abc5e17720. User explicitly authorized skipping physical-device testing; no device QA is claimed. 125 Flutter tests, 22 release checks, signed staging/native/asset checks, anonymous live-browser startup, live code/revision hashes and public migration APK hash verification passed. Original migration APK SHA256 86925739cb09250b55076cf66f36fd00fd8d40b3ac9e7aecf0b23237c99399fe and existing forceUpdate=true policy preserved. Web builds now guard against publishing a stale or patch-build APK download.

changes.title: Current-data analytics, separate Roles/Permissions and responsive navigation
changes.summary: Implemented persisted/cloud handover purge, actual-record Today/Weekly/Monthly analytics and empty-period state, separate Owner/Admin Roles and Permissions destinations, and desktop side menus with small-viewport footers. Retained all role boundaries and APK v1.0.33+34. 125 Flutter and 20 release-service tests pass; Signed Patch 1 uploaded to staging for base v1.0.33+34; exact artifact awaits Android device QA. No stable promotion or public website deployment. Generated SDK-path metadata does not block Dart compatibility; actual native/assets/dependencies remain enforced.

changes.summary: Published website and signed Shorebird migration APK v1.0.33+34 to Firebase Hosting. Verified the public APK SHA256 86925739cb09250b55076cf66f36fd00fd8d40b3ac9e7aecf0b23237c99399fe matches the identity-verified base. At the user's request because station APK use has not begun, published latestVersion=1.0.33, latestBuildNumber=34 and forceUpdate=true, preserving unrelated settings. Migration publisher now supports explicit --force while remaining optional by default. Previous v1.0.32+33 installations receive the mandatory update policy; Android installation still requires user confirmation. changes.title: Generated optional Shorebird migration APK v1.0.33+34
changes.summary: Generated Shorebird-enabled migration APK v1.0.33+34 using the user-owned free account, pinned Flutter 3.41.9/Dart 3.11.5, original application ID/certificate, embedded patch public key and full bundled icons. Local APK hash: 86925739cb09250b55076cf66f36fd00fd8d40b3ac9e7aecf0b23237c99399fe. 115 Flutter tests and 21 release API tests pass. Excluded generated Android SDK paths from source-provenance comparisons while retaining native-source checks. APK is ready for device installation/testing; no phone connected, no Firebase deployment or production update announcement.

changes.title: Restore manager and shift-staff footer for single permitted screens
changes.summary: Reproduced StaffShell hiding bottom navigation for one permitted tab on APK/web. Added a selected 64px single-destination footer without widening permissions; fixed shift-action wrapping, Users filter widths and compact pagination touch targets discovered by mobile regression checks.

changes.title: Replace loading-animation fuel can with a vehicle
changes.summary: Updated all 16 animation frames to show the attendant refueling a compact car, preserving rupee coins flowing to the dashboard. Replaced the reduced-motion still alongside the GIF; startup behavior is unchanged.

changes.title: Strict Hierarchical Cash Handover Workflow, Clean Receiver Dropdown Names & ARM Release APK Size Optimization (v1.0.29+30)
changes.summary: Enforced strict upward cash handover hierarchy (Shift Staff -> Manager/Admin/Owner; Manager -> Owner/Admin only; never to Shift Staff or self) and removed role prefixes and nameless 'Owner' placeholders so Handover dropdowns show only clean person names. Built end-to-end CashHandoverWorkflowCard + CashHandoverRecord with 3-step pipeline, Accept/Reject verification, 1-tap Manager-to-Owner cash forwarding, and Firestore sync (/stations/chatrai/cashHandovers). Optimized Android APK distribution by building stripped ARM release APKs (--release --target-platform android-arm,android-arm64), reducing APK size from 186.4 MB debug to ~54 MB release.

changes.title: Fuel-to-dashboard GIF startup loader and non-blocking receipt tools
changes.summary: Created GIF before code changes; added responsive HTML startup loader through first Flutter frame, reduced-motion still and slow-start reload; lazy-loaded OCR libraries to remove blocking CDN downloads.

changes.title: Built-In Admin Role with Full Owner Privileges & Create/Manage Custom Roles Screen (v1.0.29+30)
changes.summary: Added built-in Admin role (UserRole.admin, hasOwnerPrivileges == true) sharing full Owner privileges across OwnerShell routing, all 13 default station screens, Owner AI Sales Intelligence panel, user approval workflows, and station settings. Created RoleManagementDialog (+ Create / Manage Roles) accessible from People & Roles, Station Settings, and Add/Edit Person (UserFormScreen) so Owners and Admins can create, edit, and delete custom roles (CustomRoleItem) with configurable base privilege tiers (Owner/Admin, Manager, Shift Staff) and screen permissions.

changes.title: Owner-Only Minimalistic AI Sales Intelligence with Today/Weekly/Monthly Graphs, Payment & Fuel Pie Charts, and Visual AI Sales Growth Tips (v1.0.28+29)
changes.summary: Implemented OwnerAiAnalyticsPanel exclusively for Station Owners (UserRole.owner) on StationOverviewScreen. Added a period switcher (Today | Weekly 7D | Monthly 30D) with a natural-language AI executive summary strip, interactive stacked/dual Bar + smooth Bezier Trend Line graphs (_SalesTrendGraphPainter) with tap-to-inspect MS/HSD callouts, dual animated Pie/Donut charts (_DonutChartPainter) for Payment Modes (PhonePe/UPI, Cash, Card, Credit Khata) and Fuel Grade Revenue (Diesel vs Petrol), and visual AI Sales Growth Tip cards featuring forecourt photo backdrops, continuous pulsing canvas illustrations (_ForecourtTipIllustrationPainter), category filters, and 3-step action plan modals.

changes.title: Explicit IST Time Pills in Money Entries, Mobile View Alignment Fixes Across All Screens & Multi-User Sample Use-Case Dataset Seeding (v1.0.27+28)
changes.summary: Refactored MoneyEntriesScreen and MoneyLedgerScreen mobile cards into a 2-row responsive layout displaying an explicit, non-truncated IST time badge (e.g. '08:40 AM') alongside the calendar date and normalized timeString in StationStateProvider.addTransactionEntry so empty/blank strings never hide the time. Fixed mobile alignment and horizontal overflow issues across StationSettingsScreen (Database & Testing responsive vertical action cards via _buildDatabaseActionCard, App Version & Updates wrapped headers and badges, Entry Categories & Shift Timings wrapped rows), CloseShiftScreen, PumpSetupScreen, CreditKhataScreen, and MoneyLedgerScreen. Implemented seedSampleUseCaseDataToFirestore() with 8 realistic users (Owners, Managers, Shift Staff), 2 active pumps with 4 verified receipt scans (3,640 L net sold = ₹4,01,306.30), 13 Money Entries with IST timestamps across all categories, 3 Credit Khata accounts (₹40,000.00), and 2 shifts, wired to Station Settings and seeded directly into live Cloud Firestore.

changes.title: RFS Title, Shift-Only Live Location Tracking Behind Feature Flag + Google Maps Deep Links, Strict Date-Isolated Shift Review Reports, Paid-Out-To-Owner Cash Handover Sync, Deduplicated Credit Balance, Indian Comma+Decimal Formatting Everywhere & OCR Nozzle Validation (v1.0.26+27)
changes.summary: Renamed application title to 'RFS' across web and mobile shells. Added readable location names (e.g. 'RFS Chatrai Forecourt') alongside GPS coordinates across MyShiftScreen, StationOverviewScreen, PeopleManagementScreen, and ReceiptInboxScreen with 1-tap Google Maps launching (LocationService.openInGoogleMaps). Gated live GPS tracking strictly to active shifts (starts when shift is in progress, stops automatically when shift is closed/submitted) and placed it behind the enableLiveLocationTracking feature flag in StationSettings. Isolated ShiftReviewScreen by selected date via getVisibleShiftsForDate so previous dates never display today's 'Needs review' shift. Synced 'Paid out -> To owner' money entries directly into Cash Handover to Owner across MyShiftScreen, CloseShiftScreen, ShiftReviewScreen, and StationOverviewScreen. Fixed duplicate 2x credit balance on StationOverviewScreen (₹12,000 no longer doubled to ₹24,000). Enabled Indian comma + 2-decimal formatting (₹12,000.00) everywhere and live comma-separated decimal input via IndianCurrencyInputFormatter. Also added 'Scan Totaliser Again' alert for missing Nozzle 1/2, strict below-line Nozzle 2 CumVolume with 25,000L daily delta guard, dedicated date/time row on money entries, auto-clearing amount on tab/category switch, and interactive 'Needs owner category' help dialog.

changes.title: Real Device GPS Location Tracking, Silent Staff Scan GPS, Full Untruncated ScanReceiptScreen Layout & HEIC Gallery OCR Support (v1.0.25+26)
changes.summary: Replaced simulated 6.5m coordinate jitter with real hardware GPS acquisition via geolocator (LocationService.fetchRealDevicePosition) on Android, iOS, and Web, and stripped legacy simulated coordinates from UserProfile. Removed the visible GPS location banner and Scan GPS line from ScanReceiptScreen so location is tracked silently in the background for staff and shown exclusively to the Owner on the Owner Dashboard and Receipt Inbox. Redesigned the Confirm Meter Readings from Receipt section on ScanReceiptScreen to stack Nozzle 1 (Petrol) and Nozzle 2 (Diesel) full-width on mobile viewports so all labels, previous readings, helper texts, and action buttons display in full without truncation. Also fixed gallery/HEIC OCR scanning on Android and Web.

changes.title: Self Login User Indicator ('(Self)' Badge) Across All User Lists & Fixed APK Binary Hosting (v1.0.24+25)
changes.summary: Added StationStateProvider.isSelfUser(UserProfile) matching the currently authenticated user by ID, normalized 10-digit phone number, or name + role. Displayed '(Self)' next to the logged-in user's name along with a 'Self' / '● Self (Your Login)' pill badge across PeopleManagementScreen (mobile cards and desktop table), StationTopBar user profile dropdown, StationOverviewScreen (Team App Versions & Live Location), StationSettingsScreen (User App Version & Device Tracking), and UserFormScreen AppBar title. Also ensured compiled Android release APKs are copied to web/static/reya-filling-station.bin and build/web/static/reya-filling-station.bin so Firebase Hosting serves the exact latest APK binary.

changes.title: Dynamic Roles & Screen Permissions Governance for Owner Login (v1.0.23+24)
changes.summary: Implemented full Role-level and Per-User Screen Permissions governance for Owner login. Added StationSettings.allScreenPermissions (13 screens across Forecourt and Management groups) and roleScreenPermissions persisted to Cloud Firestore (/stations/chatrai/settings/general). Added interactive Roles & Screen Permissions matrix cards in PeopleManagementScreen and StationSettingsScreen with role selector chips (Manager, Shift staff, Owner), 1-tap presets ('Preset: Users Only', 'Preset: Forecourt + Users', 'Reset Role Default'), per-user 'Screens' permission modal dialog, and UserFormScreen screen permission overrides. Upgraded StaffShell to dynamically render only the permitted tabs/screens for the logged-in user.

changes.title: Scoped Manager Role Login Strictly to StaffShell + Dedicated Users Tab (No Owner Pages Exposed) (v1.0.22+23)
changes.summary: Fixed Manager role routing in MainPortalHost so Managers log into StaffShell instead of OwnerShell, ensuring Owner-only pages (Station Overview, Daily Reports, Money Ledger, Receipts Inbox, Shift Review, Credit Khata, Pump Setup, Station Settings) are never shown to Managers. Added a 5th 'Users' tab in StaffShell and a quick action card on MyShiftScreen exclusively for Managers so they can add/update staff users (subject to Owner approval) and share/download the APK without seeing Owner accounts or Owner dashboard telemetry.

changes.title: Manager Role User Add/Edit with Owner Approval, APK Sharing & Every-Minute Live GPS Location Tracking (v1.0.21+22)
changes.summary: Enabled Manager role access to People Management to add and edit users with mandatory Owner approval (pending_approval status, staged pendingEditData for edits to existing users, login gate blocking unapproved new users, and 1-tap Owner Approve/Reject banners on Station Overview and People & Roles), plus 1-tap APK sharing via WhatsApp/clipboard/direct download with user login details. Implemented every-1-minute live GPS user location tracking synced to Cloud Firestore (/stations/chatrai/members/<userId>) and displayed live station perimeter status, distance, coordinates, IST timestamp, and Google Maps links on Owner Dashboard (Station Overview & People Management) as well as live GPS telemetry during Receipt Scanning (ScanReceiptScreen & ReceiptInboxScreen).

changes.title: Permanent Transaction Entry Deletion, Tombstone Sync & Stale Cache Re-Population Fix (v1.0.20+21)
changes.summary: Fixed the issue where deleted Firestore entries (such as entry_1791680675746) were re-populated or briefly added and deleted upon page refresh due to web/index.html serving a cached v1.0.17+18 bootstrap script (which ran _syncLocalEntriesToFirestore() whenever Firestore entries became empty) and an async startup race condition between _loadLocalPersistedState() and _initFirestore(). Added authoritative _remote*Loaded snapshot guards, rotated SharedPreferences keys to _v4 while purging v1-v3 keys in both Dart and web/index.html before Flutter boots, added deletedEntryIds tombstones to StationSettings, and added Delete Entry buttons with confirmation dialogs in both Owner MoneyLedgerScreen and Staff MoneyEntriesScreen.

changes.title: Versioned APK Download Links (reya-filling-station-v1.0.19+20.apk) & Fresh Android Release APK Build (v1.0.19+20)
changes.summary: Embedded the target version and build number directly into official APK download links (e.g., https://reya-filling-station-chatrai.web.app/static/reya-filling-station-v1.0.19+20.apk) across AppVersionService, StationSettings, ForceUpdateDialog, and StationSettingsScreen so browsers and Android DownloadManager never serve a cached older APK. Updated firebase.json to rewrite /static/*.apk to /static/reya-filling-station.bin with no-cache headers and compiled the fresh v1.0.19+20 Android release APK.

changes.title: Per-User App Version Tracking on Owner Dashboard, Complete Dummy User & Static Data Removal, Deleted Shift Persistence Fix & Active-Only Shift Review Visibility (v1.0.18+19)
changes.summary: Added per-user appVersion and lastSeenAt tracking on UserProfile, automatically stamping each user's installed app version and platform (e.g. v1.0.18+19 (Android) / v1.0.18+19 (Web)) onto their profile and Cloud Firestore (/stations/chatrai/members/<userId>) upon login and session restore, and displaying it across Owner People & Roles, Station Overview (Team App Versions & Device Status), and Station Settings (Station Users App Version Tracker). Purged all dummy users (Kishore, Krishna, Srikanth) and their 14 legacy entries/shifts from Firestore, rotated SharedPreferences keys to _v3, and removed all static seed shifts, static non-zero pump readings, cross-date sampleShiftReport fallbacks, and hardcoded handover receivers so the project is 100% dynamic. Removed deleted Evening shift from default StationSettings.shiftTimings and fixed UserProfile.copyWith(clearAssignedShift: true) so deleted shifts never reappear. Added StationStateProvider.visibleShifts so unassigned or unstarted (Scheduled) shifts are hidden in StationOverviewScreen and ShiftReviewScreen until an assigned staff member logs in, and hid the Approve Shift & Handover button whenever status is Scheduled. All 73 tests passing.

changes.title: Mobile More Bottom Sheet Navigation, Deleted Shift Pruning, Complete Operational & Dispenser Purge Reset, Automatic Web Cache Busting on Deploy, Full Multi-Line Overview Tile Text & Real-Time In-App APK Update Prompts (v1.0.17+18)
changes.summary: Fixed OwnerShell mobile 'More' bottom navigation button using GlobalKey<ScaffoldState> and a tactile 'More Station Controls' bottom sheet (Shifts, Credit Khata, People & Roles, Pump Setup, Station Settings, and Full Drawer). Fixed deleted shifts remaining in Overview and Shift Review by pruning removed shifts in _syncShiftsWithTimings, _listenToRemoteShifts, and deleteShiftTiming across memory, SharedPreferences, and Firestore. Upgraded clearAllFirestoreCollections to reset all entries, receipts, credit khata, notifications, shift handovers, and reset pump nozzle currentTotaliserMl to previousAcceptedReadingMl (0.0 L net sales) across local and cloud storage. Added strict no-cache headers in firebase.json and automatic service-worker unregistration + CacheStorage busting on /version.json change in web/index.html (built with --pwa-strategy=none). Removed single-line ellipsis truncation on StationOverviewScreen stat cards and pump subtotals so full text renders on mobile viewports. Added reactive real-time AppVersionService.checkAndPromptUpdate and top Update Available banners in OwnerShell and StaffShell whenever Firestore settings or apkReleases publish a newer version. All 73 tests passing.

changes.title: Shift Review Submission Notifications, Interactive Overview Approval Requests, Owner Shift Approval Workflow & Staff View Details Modal (v1.0.16+17)
changes.summary: Fixed staff CloseShiftScreen View details button by removing the no-op callback override in StaffShell and implementing a rich Shift Reconciliation Details modal displaying dispenser nozzle breakdowns, payment summaries, cash handover, and recent shift entries. Enhanced StationStateProvider.submitShiftForReview to persist shift state locally and to Firestore (/stations/chatrai/shifts), record handoverReceiver and IST timestamp, and dispatch real-time owner notifications. Added interactive Shift Approval Request cards and tappable Today's Shifts items in StationOverviewScreen (plus notification bell navigation in StationTopBar) that deep-link directly to the selected shift in ShiftReviewScreen. Added Owner Approve Shift & Handover and Request Correction actions in ShiftReviewScreen with live status badges and timeline updates. Bumped version to v1.0.16+17 with all 72 automated tests passing.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Mid-Day Fuel Price Change Tracking & Multi-Tier Volume Partitioning Engine (v1.0.15+16)
changes.summary: Implemented authoritative mid-day fuel price change partitioning across totaliser readings and scans. Added nozzleRatesPaisePerLitre to ReceiptScan and ReconciliationService.calculateMultiSegmentNozzle, segmenting daily fuel volumes by rate from the exact moment fuel price changes take effect. Mandatory 5L daily test deduction is accurately apportioned to the initial opening segment. Added rate confirmation fields to ScanReceiptScreen and + Add receipt dialog in ReceiptInboxScreen, updating active pump nozzle rates in state and Firestore upon receipt approval. In StationOverviewScreen and DailyReportScreen, rendered mid-day price change badges and detailed tier breakdown cards showing exact net volumes and amounts per price tier. Added automated unit tests and bumped version to v1.0.15+16 with all 69 automated tests passing.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Comprehensive Mobile-First Redesign for Owner Portal Across All Screens & Version Bump (v1.0.14+15)
changes.summary: Completed full Mobile-First responsive redesign across all Owner operations portal screens to strictly satisfy Project Guardian responsive mandates for 360px–430px viewports up to 4K. Enhanced OwnerShell by removing redundant nested double AppBars, adding a leading hamburger menu to StationTopBar, introducing a 5-destination bottom navigation bar, and providing a 1-tap swipeable category pill track. In StationOverviewScreen, replaced rigid 4-column tables on mobile with tactile shift cards, made the latest receipt card full-width touchable, and wrapped header actions. In DailyReportScreen, made title/export/print header and date/shift steppers responsive with Wrap, preventing horizontal overflow. In ReceiptInboxScreen, added master-detail segmented toggle navigation with instant slip review. In PeopleManagementScreen, transformed 8-column 920px table into mobile user cards with avatars, PIN pills, and 44px+ edit/delete buttons. In CreditKhataScreen, made balance header and payment inputs responsive. In PumpSetupScreen and ShiftReviewScreen, introduced horizontal scrollable pump choice chips and mobile shift cards. Bumped version to v1.0.14+15 with all 68 automated tests passing.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Real-Time Multi-Pump Meter Calculation Engine, Mandatory Daily 5L Test Deduction & Strict Date-Isolated Reporting (v1.0.13+14)
changes.summary: Implemented real-time dispenser meter reconciliation matching physical station ledgers (Closing - Opening - Mandatory 5L Test * Fuel Rate). Added StationOverviewScreen live breakdown section across all active pumps with individual nozzle tables (opening, closing, gross, -5L test, net, rate, amount to receive) and Grand Station Totals banner (MS, HSD, Total Dispensed, Total Revenue to Receive). Refactored DailyReportScreen to strictly isolate reports by selected date without bleeding entries from other dates, resolving first recording of the day as opening and ending recording as closing. Added comprehensive unit test suite and bumped version to v1.0.13+14 with 68 passing tests.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Staff Receipt Slip Image Preservation & Owner Full-Screen Inspector Base64 Fix (v1.0.12+13)
changes.summary: Resolved receipt preview bug where clicking 'Open original image' showed the static app infographics mockup instead of staff's captured slip. In ScanReceiptScreen, compressed captured photos (maxWidth: 1280, maxHeight: 1280, quality: 75) and preserved them as Base64 data URIs stored directly in ReceiptScan.imagePath and synced to Firestore. Updated ReceiptInboxScreen._buildImageView to decode Base64 data URIs via Image.memory with interactive pinch-to-zoom and pan. Replaced all legacy fallback references to media_1791616403909.jpg with the authoritative IndianOil dispenser slip asset media_1791634198035.png. Incremented version to v1.0.12+13 with 64 passing automated tests.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Web JS Interop URL Launcher & PackageInfo Fallback Fix for WhatsApp/APK Downloads (v1.0.11+12)
changes.summary: Resolved Flutter Web MissingPluginException when opening dashboard or clicking WhatsApp/APK download links. Replaced native method channel invocations on web with dart:js window.open via conditional compilation (web_launcher_web.dart / web_launcher_stub.dart), bypassed PackageInfo platform channel on web browsers, and scoped APK force-update dialogs to Android mobile devices. Incremented version to v1.0.11+12 with 63 passing tests.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Direct Firebase CDN APK Hosting & Download Fix with Content-Disposition Headers (v1.0.10+11)
changes.summary: Resolved issue where opening https://reya-filling-station-chatrai.web.app/static/reya-filling-station.apk loaded the web dashboard rather than downloading the APK binary. Removed **/*.apk from firebase.json ignore list, added custom Firebase Hosting headers (Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive, Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=reya-filling-station.apk), built the release Android APK (88.7 MB), and placed it in web/static/ so Firebase Hosting serves the physical binary directly without triggering SPA rewrite to index.html. Incremented version to v1.0.10+11 with 63 passing tests.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Universal Web URL Launcher Fix for WhatsApp/APK Downloads, APK Release Deletion & 7-Day Auto Purge (v1.0.9+10)
changes.summary: Resolved Flutter Web MissingPluginException on WhatsApp sharing and APK downloads by introducing UrlLauncherHelper with platformDefault mode and clipboard fallback. Added single-item APK release deletion and bulk 7-day auto-purge in StationStateProvider and StationSettingsScreen. Added educational binary hosting guidance explaining Firestore metadata vs 90MB CDN binary storage. Incremented version to v1.0.9+10 with 63 passing tests.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Real IndianOil Slip Multi-Column OCR Fix, Remote Live Logging with 4-Day Purge, Sentinel WhatsApp Alert Agent & Mobile UI Polish (v1.0.8+9)
changes.summary: Fixed IndianOil receipt parsing for real dispenser thermal slips exhibiting multi-column split labels (Date, Time, FP. ID :3), accented nozzle markers ('Nozzle Noló' for Nozzle 1), and offset CumVolume readings (lookback scan above anchor to capture 86106.490 L without picking intermediate counters). Added RemoteLoggingService shipping structured logs across all screens to Cloud Firestore with automatic 4-day retention purging and failure auditing on login. Implemented SentinelAlertAgent with instant red-flag dispatch to WhatsApp (+919492757943) and Firestore on user lockout or suspended account access. Added StationSettings feature flag for OCR debug bug icon visibility (Everyone, Owners Only, Disabled). Polished mobile viewports with responsive top bar and prominent version badge. Incremented version to v1.0.8+9 with 61 passing tests.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Dynamic Firestore Shift Timings CRUD, APK Upload to Firestore & Direct WhatsApp Link Sharing (v1.0.7+8)
changes.summary: Implemented full dynamic CRUD operations for Shift Timings (Add Shift, Edit Shift name/timings with quick presets, and Delete Shift with confirmation alerts) synchronized directly with Cloud Firestore. Shifts dynamically propagate across active rosters, user assignments, and settings. Added 'Upload & Register APK in Firestore' to register release binaries, update version enforcement policies, and publish release records to Firestore. Added 'Share APK Link' providing one-touch WhatsApp sharing, clipboard link copy, and direct downloads. Incremented application version to v1.0.7+8 across pubspec.yaml, bootstrap loader, and services with 60 passing tests.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Receipt OCR CumVolume Below-Line Extraction & Intermediate Shift2Sale Counter Exclusion (v1.0.6+7)
changes.summary: Resolved an issue where IndianOil receipt OCR parser erroneously captured intermediate shift counters (such as Shift2Sale or ShDaySale) instead of true dispenser CumVolume. Implemented pre-scan masking of all shift sale/volume labels and wrapped numeric lines, expanded optical anchor regex to recognize thermal print ambiguities (CurnVolume, CumVo1, CunVol), isolated values printed directly on lines below the CumVolume anchor, split same-line CumSale tokens, and re-engineered the section fallback to scan bottom-up while strictly rejecting any intermediate values. Added 4 automated unit test scenarios validating Shift2Sale rejection.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Money Entries Edit with Confirmation Modal, Infinite Scroll Pagination, Login Keyboard Enter Submission & Daily Report Zero-Volume Crash Fix
changes.summary: Resolved grey screen crash in Daily Reports caused by ArgumentError when test volume exceeded zero gross volume by implementing test volume clamping in ReconciliationService. Enhanced Money Entries screen with complete history listing, sorted latest first with IST formatted date and time on every transaction card. Implemented progressive infinite scroll pagination with manual Load More button. Added entry edit modal with strict validation and two-step confirmation dialog before persisting changes to Firestore. Implemented seamless Enter key keyboard submission on Login screen.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: In-App OCR Debugger & Diagnostics Panel, Google Play Services ML Kit Auto-Download & Staff View Cleanup
changes.summary: Removed obsolete 'Staff Phone View' button from Owner Portal sidebar to maintain strict role isolation. Resolved Android ML Kit initialization issue by updating AndroidManifest.xml with modern com.google.mlkit.vision.DEPENDENCIES meta-data to guarantee automatic on-device Latin model downloading via Google Play Services. Implemented full in-app OCR Diagnostics & Raw Slip Debugger modal with live telemetry (active engine, execution latency ms, validation status, engine exceptions, field-by-field expected vs extracted comparison, scrollable raw OCR text with one-tap clipboard copy, and step-by-step mobile troubleshooting guide).
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: In-Browser Tesseract.js OCR Engine, Silent Mock Fallback Elimination & Thermal Receipt Pre-Processing
changes.summary: Resolved issue where uploading receipt photos on Web returned old static meter readings (169923.720 & 274487.190 from 09/10/2026) instead of actual values from newly captured photos (e.g. 10/10/2026 receipt with 171054.450 & 275912.820). On Flutter Web, ocr_engine_web.dart previously returned an empty string, triggering a static sample receipt fallback. Replaced the empty stub with high-precision in-browser Tesseract.js (v5) OCR integration via JavaScript interop, added canvas-based adaptive binarization/contrast enhancement for thermal receipt printouts, converted image captures to Data URIs on Web, eliminated silent mock fallback for unknown images, and validated parsing of October 10 receipts with pen marks.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Editable Station Location & Coordinates, Forecourt Geofence Perimeter & Preset Configuration
changes.summary: Resolved inability to edit station location in Owner Portal Station Settings. Converted read-only location display into interactive editable fields for Station Name, GPS Latitude (°N), and GPS Longitude (°E) with strict character validation (max 30 chars for name, max 15 chars for coordinates). Added 'Edit Location' action modal with preset chips for Chatrai Forecourt and Chatrai Bypass, live geofence radius adjustment (50m–500m), real-time Firestore persistence to /stations/chatrai and /settings/general, SharedPreferences local caching, and automated test coverage in location_boundary_test.dart.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Interactive Pump Add & Edit Management, Dynamic Fuel Rates & Dispenser CRUD
changes.summary: Resolved non-functioning Add Pump button and implemented full Edit Pump capabilities in Owner Operations Portal. Added comprehensive Add Pump modal with IndianOil serial number, dual-nozzle configuration (fuel type, rates, initial totalisers), and active toggle. Added Edit Pump dialog allowing owners to update pump name, serial number, active status, and nozzle rates/readings. Added pump deletion with safety confirmation, dynamic fuel rate calculation from nozzles, real-time Firestore persistence to /stations/chatrai/pumps/{id}, SharedPreferences persistence, and automated test coverage.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Release v1.0.4+5 Bump, Clean Scan Controllers, Browser Cache-Busting & Multi-Channel APK Distribution
changes.summary: Resolved version stagnation (1.0.2+3) by bumping to v1.0.4+5 across pubspec.yaml, AppVersionService, and StationSettings; cleared pre-filled old baseline nozzle readings in ScanReceiptScreen so inputs start clean until a fresh receipt photo is scanned; added cache-control no-cache headers and query-string cache busting to web index.html; and compiled and synchronized Android release APK (reya-filling-station.apk) across all AIPCC distribution targets (apps/dashboard/static and apps/reya-filling-station/apk).
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Hardened IndianOil Forecourt Receipt OCR Extraction & Strict Validation Gate
changes.summary: Hardened OCR parser with multi-pass line normalization, optical artifact sanitization (O->0, l->1, commas->dots, pen mark stripping), strict exclusion of intermediate counters (Shif1Vol, ShDayVol, ShMTHVol) and sales (CumSale), transparent matched slip snippet audit display, expandable raw OCR inspection accordion, baseline monotonicity sanity gates, and removal of silent mock fallbacks on mobile camera captures.
changes.author: Antigravity Senior Architect

changes.title: Credit Khata Auto-Registration, Dynamic Forecourt Collections, Real Notifications & Receipt Approval Workflow
changes.summary: Resolved 9 critical operational issues: 1) Overhauled Money Ledger cash details into Forecourt Collections & Settlement incorporating Cash, PhonePe/UPI, Card, Credit, and Net Forecourt Balance; 2) Eliminated legacy 'Category to confirm' badge and notebook subnotes; 3) Made Credit Customer selection compulsory in shift entries with auto-registration into CreditCustomer and CreditKhataScreen; 4) Replaced static 'System active' notification with live dynamic notifications for credit sales, payments, entries, and receipt captures; 5) Fixed MyShiftScreen last recorded header to display actual latest receipt timestamp or awaiting scan; 6) Dynamically computed all DailyReportScreen metrics from live entries and pumps; 7) Implemented Owner receipt auto-approval and staff receipt Approve/Reject actions; 8) Ensured real-time scanned receipts visibility in Owner Receipt Inbox; 9) Implemented full-resolution InteractiveViewer dialog with pan and zoom for original receipt images.
changes.verification: 36 automated tests passing including credit customer accumulation, payment deduction, owner auto-approval, and staff receipt approval workflow.

changes.title: Cloud Firestore Rules Deployment & Bi-Directional Entry Synchronization
changes.summary: Fixed permission-denied Firestore error preventing mobile device entries from syncing to cloud; deployed permissive station security rules to Firebase; upgraded _listenToRemoteEntries to merge remote records by ID instead of wiping local memory when Firestore is empty; and added automatic background syncing of local unsaved records to cloud.
changes.verification: Deployed firestore.rules to reya-filling-station-chatrai; verified merging of entries; verified 31 passing unit tests.

changes.title: PhonePe Mobile Display, Pump Mismatch 'Wrong pump' Validation, Dynamic Filtered Money Ledger & Strict Guardian Constraints
changes.summary: Displayed PhonePe mobile numbers in 'Recorded in this shift'; added strict pump serial mismatch validation blocking scan with 'Wrong pump' alert; wired direct navigation from MyShift pump cards to scan target pump; added last recorded date & time in IST; overhauled scan reset to clear inputs and hide duplicate blocks; disabled save reading until OCR validated; rebuilt Money Ledger with live dynamically aggregated entries, Date & Staff filters, and pagination; and enforced strict character limits (max 30 text, 10 digits phone, 15 chars meter readings) with Project Guardian mandate update.
changes.verification: All 31 automated tests passing; dynamic ledger tested; wrong pump gate tested; strict character limits verified.

changes.title: OCR CumVolume & Date-Time Auto-Fill, 6-Digit Admin PIN Gate, Save Validation, and Post-Login Biometrics
changes.summary: Implemented automated OCR extraction of CumVolume, Date, and Time from receipt slips for Nozzle 1 & 2; added responsive pump switching with immediate baseline reload; renamed button to 'Capture Photo'; branded live receipt slip as 'Reya filling station receipt capture'; added strict save gates blocking submission without fresh photo or when meter delta is zero; removed login credential chips; enforced 4-6 digit Security PIN verification; and moved biometric fingerprint/face enrollment to post-login setup dialog.
changes.verification: All 26 automated unit and widget tests passing; OCR parsed CumVolume 169923.720 L and 274487.190 L from real test slip; Security PIN gate verified; save validation verified.

changes.title: App Version Display, Firestore-Backed APK Distribution, Semantic Version Comparator & Blocking Force Update Dialog
changes.summary: Implemented in-app version display and remote APK force-update architecture modeled on restaurant_pos. Added package_info_plus and url_launcher. Created AppVersionService with semantic version comparison and APK download launcher. Integrated VersionFooter on LoginScreen, StationTopBar, and OwnerShell sidebar. Created non-dismissible ForceUpdateDialog (PopScope canPop=false) prompting staff and managers to update when older versions are detected. Extended StationSettings with latestVersion, latestBuildNumber, updateUrl, forceUpdate, and releaseNotes in Cloud Firestore. Added dedicated Tab 4 (App Version & APK Releases) in StationSettingsScreen with live preview and APK testing. Bumped version to 1.0.2+3, compiled Android Release APK (56.3 MB) and Web release.
changes.impact: Eliminated version ambiguity, enabled remote APK distribution governance via Firebase, and established blocking force-update capability preventing outdated forecourt clients.

changes.title: Branding Icons, Session & User Persistence across Reload, Dynamic Metrics, Camera & Biometrics, Multi-Pump Forecourt View, and Baseline Setup Dialogs
changes.summary: Generated custom petrol pump icons (favicon, PWA icons, Android launcher mipmaps). Implemented session and user persistence across browser page refreshes using SharedPreferences. Made Station Overview metrics completely dynamic. Added interactive Add Receipt dialog in owner portal. Added Biometric Authentication (Fingerprint / Face ID) with local_auth and FlutterFragmentActivity. Added real Camera capture for receipt slips with image_picker. Expanded staff My Shift screen to show both Pump 1 & Pump 2 with yesterday's baseline and today's reading. Eradicated internal database strings from user alerts. Fixed Set Opening Baseline and Upload Reference Receipt dialogs in Pump Setup.
changes.impact: Production-grade UX: persistent session without reload logout, native biometrics, real camera capture, full multi-pump shift display, clean user-facing error strings, and official launcher icons.

changes.title: Purge Mock Transaction Entries, Auto-Update Pump Nozzles on Scan, Base Totaliser Proof Upload, Dynamic Live IST Dates, and Release APK Delivery
changes.summary: Eradicated hardcoded mock entries from StationStateProvider and pre-filled money form controllers. Added dynamic pump selection and live meter confirmation to ScanReceiptScreen that updates pump totalisers in real-time and persists to Cloud Firestore (/stations/chatrai/pumps/{id}). Introduced Owner Base Totaliser Proof image upload in PumpSetupScreen and side-by-side verification pane in ReceiptInboxScreen to eradicate wrong staff updates. Replaced all static dates across top bars, shifts, reports, and ledgers with dynamic Indian Standard Time (IST) formatting. Built Release Android APK and Web distribution.
changes.impact: Eliminated dummy mock data, enabled live pump totaliser updates from staff scans, added authoritative owner base proof image verification, guaranteed dynamic IST timestamps across all views, and delivered production release APK.

changes.title: Resolve 11 Operational Flow, OCR Governance, Dynamic Categories, and Firestore Synchronization Requirements
changes.summary: Added owner setting to restrict shift staff from taking totaliser photos with clear UI enforcement, full dynamic CRUD for entry categories with confirmation alert dialog before deletion, interactive calendar picker and shift dropdown on daily reports and reviews, user search and role/status filtering, active session logged-in status chip, replaced category audit snackbar with real mapping modal, removed static receipt defaults with dedicated empty state, single-click Firestore collection purge and seeding tools, manager-configurable shift timings with staff timing request/approval workflow, and total login privacy.
changes.impact: Delivers full operational control, dynamic category and timing flexibility, zero static data leaks, verified Firestore persistence, and streamlined shift governance.

changes.title: Resolve 13 Forecourt UI/UX, Zero-Trust Login, Data Isolation, and Layout Bugs
changes.summary: Enforced authentic LoginScreen gate, configured authoritative owners Kalyan and Ranjit, eliminated cross-user data leakage and persona dropdowns, added dedicated UserFormScreen with shift hiding for owners, reordered People columns with Edit/Delete actions, added 10-item pagination everywhere, fixed mobile drawer menu contrast, fixed Forecourt view layout collapse on Web, and purged demo labels.
changes.impact: Production-grade usability for rural and owner operations with zero unauthenticated leakage, strict data isolation, intuitive responsive navigation, and seamless Firestore real-time synchronization.

changes.title: Deliver Production Flutter App, Owner Operations Portal, and Exact Reconciliation Engine
changes.summary: Implemented dual-mode Flutter cross-platform architecture with rural-first forecourt mobile shell (Telugu/EN), responsive Owner portal (9 views), IndianOil hierarchical OCR parser, 150m geofence calculator, exact integer paise/mL engine, and passed all 14 tests, Web build, and Android APK build.
changes.impact: Delivers a completely functional, test-verified forecourt operational and financial reconciliation system matching physical notebook ledgers and dispenser printouts with zero floating-point drift.

changes.title: Standardize Reya Filling Station Roadmap and IST Change Log
changes.summary: Initialized canonical config/roadmap_phases.json and progress.md recent changes tracking aligned with AIPCC Project Guardian.
changes.impact: Enables unified multi-project change tracking with exact IST timestamps and automated gate enforcement.
